headline: Congress Observes 9/11 Anniversary as Senate Prepares for Judicial Nominations Vote

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on September 10 and adjourned with no business conducted. The chamber will return Monday with a cloture vote scheduled on the nomination of Matthew R. Byrne for U.S. District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio.

onTheFloor.title: United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio
onTheFloor.status: cloture vote scheduled for approximately 5:30 PM Monday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on September 10 for a brief pro forma session, adjourning immediately as a mark of respect on the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. H. Res. 1520 expressing remembrance of that date was agreed to unanimously.
